store_policies.note_shipping: No guaranteed 24h/48h shipping SLA is published at checkout; copy must not promise delivery times.

mandatory_exclusions_on_promo_sends: VIP / Champions (3+ orders or top 20% spend)
Full-Price Repeat Buyers (never needed a coupon)
Purchased in last 14 days (recent buyer cooldown)
CX hold active (stuck parcel / 1-2 star review / recent ticket, from the CX promo guard)
